At the time of Ken Koza’s retirement in 1988, Barnum stood poised for growth with 12 employees and an opportunity to provide manufacturers with thoughtful industrial solutions and a detailed knowledge of automation controls. Today the company proudly employs over 130 people, operating a 65,000 square foot facility in its Brighton, Michigan Headquarters and stocking offices in Cleveland, Ohio and Grand Rapids, Michigan.

Rheonics empowers the world’s most critical industries to automate fluid process control. We replace outdated sampling methods with robust, inline viscosity and density sensors that allow you to evaluate fluid properties instantly. Just as a peer checker spots errors in design, Rheonics spots inefficiencies in your pipe—correcting quality issues before they become waste.

We turn fluid dynamics into sustainability wins. By enabling tight, real-time control, we help you eliminate the over-processing and material waste that creates unnecessary emissions and costs.

Why leaders in Food, O&G, Pharma, and Consumer Goods choose Rheonics:

Optimize Quality: Automate consistency in mixing, coating, and reaction processes.

Drive Sustainability: Significantly reduce energy usage, scrap rates, and solvent emissions.

Proven ROI: Trusted by global Tier-1 companies to lower BOM costs and prevent quality escapes.

Rheonics is the global leader in inline fluid process sensing. We make it effortless for automation engineers and plant operators to monitor critical fluid properties—viscosity and density—directly within the process line. Our patented balanced torsional resonator technology allows our sensors to withstand the harshest environments, analyzing your fluids in real-time.

Name: Adaptive Buildings
Description:
Buildings don’t fail because people don’t care. They fail because reality is messier than the model.

We’ve seen carefully designed systems underperform the moment people move in.

Not through negligence but through use. Through change. Through, let’s face it, perfectly reasonable human behavior.

We believe good engineering starts by accepting that fact.

Instead of engineering for drawings or theoretical occupants, we engineer for the people who have to live with the building at 7pm on a Tuesday. The people who notice the drafts, inherit the systems and spend their evenings convincing the automated lighting that someone is, in fact, still in the room.

Because optimization without usability isn’t optimization at all. A system that looks efficient but frustrates its users will eventually be worked around, or switched off entirely.

That’s why we treat building performance as a continuous responsibility, rather than a one-time achievement.

We Design with the people, the space and the purpose front and center.
We Nurture through installation and adoption, helping people understand and trust the systems they inherit.
We Analyze performance honestly, comparing what we expected with what actually happens.
And we Adapt, because buildings change - and pretending they don’t is how performance decays.

This isn’t a proprietary framework or a silver bullet. It’s simply what happens when you pay attention for long enough to see buildings as more than walls and systems; as environments continually shaped by, and shaping, the people inside them.

And if a building’s role doesn’t end at handover, then neither does ours.

We’re not here to build monuments. We’re here to leave a legacy (no, not that kind).

A living legacy: building systems that perform and adapt, with us and for the people who rely on them, for evolutions to come.

Name: QTRCO, Inc.
Description:
QTRCO is a manufacturer of actuators that are engineered and crafted without compromise.  Our mission has always been to produce the safest, most reliable and easy to maintain actuators on the market.  We never compromise the safety of our actuator designs and the captured spring system located inward of the pistons allows safe access for replacement while the actuator is installed on the valve.  All QTRCO actuators are designed with the belief that actuators should not fail.  From the unique design features to the premium materials of construction we have the confidence to offer a 3-year performance warranty.  Ease of maintenance infers that you may need to perform maintenance on a QTRCO actuator which is unlikely.  However should inspection or repair of the actuator be required, the QTRCO actuator does not require any proprietary parts, special training, or removal from the valve.

From our beginning in 1996, QTRCO has offered unique solutions to address common actuator problems.  Minimizing friction, internal side loading, and the number of seals have resulted in actuators that are ideally suited for control as well as on/off applications.  The QTRCO XRCISER partial stroke testing device is the only actuator that offers pneumatically engaged travel stops to ensure no spurious valve travel and full emergency operation capability.  Adapters have been engineered to fit all valve types as well as direct mounting to many valves.  Low cost solutions for Full Tag-Out/Lock-Out and manual override are also available options.

Please contact us via our website at www.qtrco.com for more information.

Description:

IntelliFlux’s core technology is made possible through the company’s deep expertise in three key engineering disciplines: process technologies and their operation, software innovation, and plant automation.

Through our own experience in system and plant integration, we recognized a major gap between how process engineers design and envision the control philosophy and how the automation control logic is actually programmed at these plants. To address this gap, we developed an approach that would apply the designed process dynamics to the control architecture, implement complex control strategies (such as MIMO, optimal control, and adaptive control), as well as learn from the process behavior. This unique blend of digital replica and machine learning makes APRICOT by IntelliFlux a radically different, efficient, and effective approach to process automation. And, by retrofitting existing plants in a completely hardware agnostic manner, we have time and again shown our customers the true potential of their process plants, and how much of that value they can recapture with the APRICOT solution suite.

Name: Vertech
Description:
Vertech is an industrial control systems integration firm providing a complete range of engineering and technical services. We work with system owners, engineering firms, contractors, and OEMs to design and build world-class industrial control systems. Name: Inbolt
Description:
Inbolt is on a mission to make vision-guided robotics the norm, not the exception, on the shop floor. 

Automation is no longer optional in manufacturing, but traditional solutions are costly due to the need for rigid infrastructure like jigs, indexing systems, and stop-and-go lines.

Inbolt is changing that. Their AI-powered robotic guidance enables flexible, smart automation in unstructured and dynamic environments. The generalist AI requires no custom tuning, adapts to any application, and delivers real-time, vision-based robot guidance.

They’re trusted by leaders like Stellantis, Renault, Toyota and Ford with deployments in over 50 factories across Europe, the U.S., and Japan. 

In particular, their real-time guidance capability enables automation on continuously moving assembly lines, the final frontier of factory automation. 

Backed by $20M from SOSV, Exor, and MIG, Inbolt is setting a new standard for robotics in manufacturing.

Along with Sojo ShieldTM, a blockchain-based track-and-trace platform offering real-time geolocation and supply chain insights, Sojo is pioneering efficient, data-driven variety packaging for Fortune 500 enterprises and emerging brands. Name: Petrotech Inc
Description:
With over 50 years of experience and thousands of installations worldwide, Petrotech provides customized control solutions in a full turnkey package, from engineering concept to installation and commissioning. 

Petrotech provides an extensive range of products and engineering services for rotating machinery and plant control system upgrades, mechanical retrofits, standalone control products and new equipment solutions for turbomachinery industry OEMs. 

Petrotech’s products include integrated control systems for gas, hydro and steam turbines, generators, reciprocating/diesel engines, compressors, centrifugal and axial compressors, pumps and all associated ancillary systems. Our turnkey services include engineering design (software and hardware), project management, control panel fabrication, system integration, site I&E services, commissioning, training, customer service and startup. 

Petrotech has remained committed to providing its customers with advanced controls that improve the performance and mechanical reliability of turbo and rotating machinery. This commitment is demonstrated by continued focus and improvement of its core competencies and turnkey solutions. 
Advances in the company’s control software development have allowed Petrotech to develop its fully open architecture so that it continues to be transportable to all major commercially available control platforms. These Petrotech control algorithms are based on application knowledge of the company’s founding members and extensive field experience. The advanced functionality continues to evolve with the development of additional capabilities that serve the customer’s ever-changing needs. 

In our peer group of turbomachinery control system companies, Petrotech provides the most innovative solutions for unusual and difficult control challenges. 

Our corporate office is located in New Orleans, Louisiana, with full-service offices in Houston, Texas and Bury St. Edmunds, Surrey, in the UK.

Name: ROS-Industrial
Description:
Our Brief History

The ROS-Industrial Open Source project began as the collaborative endeavor of Yaskawa Motoman Robotics, Southwest Research Institute, and Willow Garage to support the use of ROS for manufacturing automation. The software repository, hosted on GitHub, was founded by Shaun Edwards (SwRI) in January 2012. Led by SwRI, the ROS-Industrial Consortium Americas launched in March 2013. As you might have guessed from the name, there is also a ROS-I Consortium Europe, led by Fraunhofer IPA in Stuttgart, Germany, and a ROS-Industrial Consortium Asia Pacific, led by ARTC and NTU in Singapore. The Consortia exists to support the ROS-Industrial community by providing training, technical support, and setting the roadmap for ROS-I. The Consortia also conduct pre-competitive joint industry projects to develop new capabilities for ROS-I.

Heading off this crisis demands creative solutions for closing the skills gap and investing in a workforce able to meet the increasing demands of advanced manufacturing.

By the end of 2018, more than 100 veterans will have graduated from The Academy; by 2020, our goal is to scale that number to 1000 veterans per year.

For metal stampers: Pascal offers Quick Die Change (QDC) systems designed to reduce the time it takes to complete a die change. QDC can help to prevent accidents caused by mis-clamping as it has an interlock system that will not allow a die change to proceed until all clamps are properly secured. It can inform the operator exactly which clamps need to be adjusted.
The system includes hydraulic die clamps, clamp holders, control units, die lifters, and pre-rollers. A common die plate is needed in order to implement the fully automated systems. We offer installations and can also retrofit existing presses with QDC.

For injection molders: Pascal automatic quick mold change system (QMC) ensures more time for production because molds can be loaded onto the changer in preparation for the next changeover while the IMM is currently in operation, stopping only for a quick switch. In addition to QMC, injection molders can gain more time savings with magnetic clamping, magnetic ejector rods, octagonal locate ring, automatic couplers, and automatic die setting/leveling.

For cnc machinists and fixture builders: Our wide array of hydraulic and pneumatic workholding clamps is ideal for high-production applications, metal cutting, welding, milling machines and material handling. The clamp lineup includes swing clamps, link clamps, work supports, couplers, rotary joints, and zero point clamping. Many of these clamps include sensors to perform seat checks. ROBOTS THAT FEEL

Our technology was born in the Department of Biomedical Engineering at the University of Southern California in 2007 with the vision of giving hand amputees human-like hand dexterity unlike the rudimentary functions of simple prosthetic hands. Name: Naftosense
Description:
The Trusted Source in Hydrocarbon Leak Detection

Naftosense designs and manufactures hydrocarbon leak detection systems based on addressable products which detect the presence of hydrocarbons such as refined fuel, light / heavy crude oils, lubricants, dielectric oils, solvents, and petrochemical compounds.

Naftosense Leak Detection systems are extremely sensitive to hydrocarbon liquids and gasses. Some customers have base line contamination in their facilities that cause other leak detection systems to alarm in "normal" operation. Others have problems during periods of excessive rainfall where hydrocarbons are released from the soil triggering a false alarm. Naftosense solves ALL micro-exposure alarm issues by allowing real time volume reporting and field adjustability of the sensor to calibrate for existing conditions. 

In addition, the Acquisition Module will report progressive leak alarms as the volume of the leak increases. Sensors are rugged and built to be immersed in a leak environment and still report the "increasing leak volume" until the sensor becomes completely saturated at full alarm. After the leak is remediated, Naftosense sensors can be re-set and re-installed. Only when the sensor is completely saturated will you need to use our simple cleaning technique involving common household chemicals. Naftosense sensors can be re-used with confidence for 10 years or more! 

The science behind Naftosense products is Polymer Absorption Sensor (PAS) technology (specifically in Naftosense products, Elastomer Absorption Sensors). Developed in the 1950s, PAS technology has a proven track record of detecting hydrocarbons in extreme conditions and enables real-time, cost-effective critical infrastructure integrity monitoring. Because of the seamless integration with existing infrastructure, Naftosense technology is deployed quickly and easily in almost any facility.

This page provides information about the Cell Processor, a device designed specifically for the purification of adherent cells. The Cell Processor enables the purification and refinement of adherent cells directly within their culture vessels, without requiring cell dissociation. Using AI-based label-free or fluorescent labeling methods, it identifies unwanted cells and eliminates them non-invasively through laser irradiation. By maintaining cell culture during this short and stress-free process, the device helps preserve cell vitality. This innovative technology employs a light responsive polymer coating applied to the culture vessel, which undergoes photothermal conversion at specific wavelengths. When the laser irradiates unwanted cells identified by AI, the polymer generates localized heat, effectively destroying only the targeted cells. The device is equipped with software that allows users to create customized AI models for cell identification tailored to their own cell types. This eliminates the need for complicated pre-processing steps prior to purification and offers the convenience of simply placing the culture vessel into the device. As a result, researchers can focus their time on other tasks. Applications include purification of hiPSC and their differentiated derivatives, production of uniform-sized embryoid bodies (EBs), and cell patterning. These capabilities contribute to improved consistency and product quality in both research and biomanufacturing fields.

Most wireless vibration sensors send summaries. RMS, peak, temperature, a few trend points. Useful, but a summary has already thrown away the signal the diagnosis lives in. As far as we know, we are the only company delivering the full vibration waveform wirelessly over LoRaWAN, so the AI works adequately in challenging environments for years without sensor maintenance.

That is the whole difference. You cannot diagnose a fault from a trend line that already discarded the data. Our AI reads the real waveform, and diagnosis accuracy runs about 97.5%.

WHAT WE BUILD

AirVibe, wireless triaxial sensor on LoRaWAN. Overall RMS every five minutes, plus full-resolution time waveform pushed several times a day. The signal penetrates plant structure well past 400 m, and the low-power radio is what buys multi-year battery life.

TriVibe, wired daisy-chained sensors streaming the full waveform continuously, for unit-critical machines and transient faults like pump cavitation.

Twin Prox, eddy-current proximity probes and transmitters for journal-bearing machines and turbomachinery.

MultiViz, the software layer. The AI flags the fault, points at the likely cause, and tells your team what to inspect, so a bearing change stays a planned job instead of a weekend shutdown.

WHO WE SERVE

Oil and gas, midstream, power generation, cement, pulp and paper, metals, mining, data centers, hospitals and critical facilities, food and beverage, and water treatment.

Veteran-owned and based in Houston, Texas. Our founders have more than 75 years of combined experience in vibration monitoring and machine reliability.

For most products made from hemp stalks, the first step is decorticating; separating the outer bast fiber from the inner woody core called hurd.

Currently, there are small, hand fed decorticating machines available from China, Australia and the USA and large, multi-million dollar complete processing lines from Europe. Currently in the US many farmers are searching for a way to make money on the crop and a lot of them are turning to CBD Oils and Seeds.
You most definitely can make a good income on just the seeds alone as they are going for around $25-$35 per lb with a yield of around 1 lb per plant and around 2,500 plants per acre, that around $60,000 per acre.

That is only half of the value that this plant can produce, and farmers are missing out on the full potential of the hemp plant. Here at 6ix Hemp Inc we plan on changing that.

6ix Hemp Inc will travel to your farm, process and ready your crop for distribution right there on your property. With our high-powered Hemp Decorticators we can take care of all your hemp needs, from hurd, fibers, seeds, oils, shiv etc.

We will also be able to process all your material right there on location. This allowing us two ways to process material and allow us the ability to go from machine to farm (mobile decortication), farm to machine (shipped to us for processing).

This Mobile Decortication System is a Win/Win business solution for the industrial hemp industry. Farmer will get onsite Decortication and Processing, and distribution companies will get to move inventory in a much easier, faster and streamlined way.

Name: Smart Production Systems LLC
Description:
Smart Production Systems LLC is a startup founded by Dr. Semyon M. Meerkov (Professor, University of Michigan) and his former graduate students: Dr. Liang Zhang (Associate Professor, University of Connecticut), and Dr. Pooya Alavian. In addition, the company includes a Board of Advisors consisting of Lawrence Achram (Vice President, Fiat Chrysler, retired) and Dr. David Cole (Chairman, Center for Automotive Research, retired). 

The goal of the startup is to commercialize the technology of Production Systems Engineering (PSE) developed at the University of Michigan during the last 30 years and supported by six NSF grants (1991-2015) and three NIST grants (2016 – present). More specifically, the goal is to complete the development and to market a device referred to as Programmable Manufacturing Advisor (PMA). This device is the main part of Smart Production Systems (SPS), which we define as systems capable of diagnosing their “health” and providing the Operation Manager (OM) with an analytically calculated advice for achieving the desired productivity improvement. PMA is somewhat similar to PLC (Programmable Logic Controller); the difference is that while PLC is intended for equipment automation, PMA is intended for automation of decision-making in manufacturing environment.

Description:
Multi-modular Electric Vehicle System (MEVS) – The Dynamic and Transformative Vehicle System (DTVS)!

Electric vehicle platform is flat and has no gas line and exhaust system going through its body, and therefore presenting an opportunity to divide its platform into two sections or transformable modules: a driving module (head) and a non-driving module (tail)!     

The electric vehicle front section consists of operational and control components of a vehicle and costs at least 70% and the rear section about 30%.

Modular vehicle concepts are applied by automakers to make various vehicle models with standard platform and modular components. However, these practices only simplify the manufacturing processes and reduce manufacturing costs.

The MEVS consists of a driving vehicle module (Head) and a plurality of non-driving vehicle modules (Tails), such as SUV, truck-bed, tool/passenger vans, RV. 

The driving vehicle module with all functions as an independent operable vehicle with two front wheels and a retractable single wheel at rear-middle position of the vehicle retracted into its housing compartment after the driving module is coupled with a non-driving module.  

The non-driving modules have at least two wheels located at rear section of the modules; a retractable supporting structure located at front section of the modules for parking and are retracted into compartments housing it and its actuator when the non-driving module is coupled and configured with a driving vehicle module and ready to operate. A standard coupling and configuration system is applied to compile all types of vehicle modules.

The transforming vehicles may be switched and resembled with wireless controller and with no driver seating inside the vehicle.

The Multi-modular Electric Vehicle System may also enable light commercial fleet and parcel delivery vehicles load, swap and drop ship like semi-trucks, eliminating vehicle loading and idling time, reduce labor and operational costs.

Description:
We don’t just detail cars; we engineer their light, lines, and presence.
Midnight Duo exists for drivers who see their car as more than transport – it’s a moving piece of industrial design with its own visual identity.

Based in San Jose, we specialize in Light Contour Engineering and LCC (Lux Contour Correction) – an approach that treats every panel as sculpture and every reflection as an optical decision. We analyze panel curvature, surface topology, and specular highlights, then tune micro-geometry so the car’s optical behavior matches a clear brief: more elegant, more muscular, more classic, or more future-leaning. Instead of chasing generic gloss or “X-year coatings,” we start by defining how the car should be read in light and in motion.

Once the light signature and bodylines are calibrated, we lock that work in with a layered coating architecture and a realistic maintenance protocol. The coating becomes a controlled optical interface over an already-engineered surface, not a shortcut. The result isn’t just a clean car; it’s a stable, engineered character with consistent light behavior that still looks deliberate months and years after it leaves the driveway.

Description:
Eshet Eilon is an innovative agricultural equipment developer, established in 1935. Eshet Eilon develops sorting and conveying systems for different products. The company provides turnkey, user friendly solutions for handling fruits and vegetables. The company's systems manage the entire process - from recieving the product, to dumping, hot water treatment, cleaning, waxing, drying, sorting and grading all the way to packing the products.

The systems and solutions of Eshet Eilon are developed and designed for a vast veriaty of industries. Each order is custum-made in order to fit the client's specific needs. Eshet Eilon uses the latest technologies for sorting and grading agricultural products, making sure that only the best products go into packing:
 
Weight sizing - The company has numerous cup and roller graders designed especially for each product. The different graders are divided by size, shape and speed - in order to match the product. 

Each grader comes with a very accurate weighting system that weights each 
fruit and grades it according to the settings of the system by the client.  
 
Optical grading – according to size, color and external defects: the company's optic system serves as another tool in order to get high quality products. The optic system includes high quality color digital cameras that scan the surface of each product. The products are categorized by color, size, diameter, texture defects and external defects. 
 
Internal grading - NIR technology - NIR is Near InfraRed. NIR systems use special wave length that can penetrate into the internal part of the product and analyze its chemical properties due to the waves the product returns.

Our MANET-based architecture reduces Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR) by ≥50% under high-loss network conditions, enabling manufacturing floors and forward-deployed operations to maintain authorization continuity during connectivity loss.

Probabilistic Trust Scores for decentralized device authorization
Mesh network synchronization (<500ms recovery)
Zero-Knowledge Proofs for contested environments

Manufacturing (automotive, aerospace, discrete manufacturing) and defense logistics where downtime costs exceed $100K/hour.

Name: Laser Bonding Technology
Description:
Laser bonding is an established technology that uses lasers to bond additive marking material to a wide variety of different substrates and is commonly used with CO2, Nd:YAG and Fiber lasers.

The technology was first invented in the mid 1990s by Paul W. Harrison, the founder of TherMark. After selling his interest in TherMark, he went on to found Laser Bonding Technology and continues to be involved with laser marking hardware and the further development of new and unique marking materials.  These new products produce permanent marks on most metal, glass, ceramic and stone surfaces for use in a wide range of industrial and artistic applications, ranging from automotive, aerospace and medical to the awards & personalization industries.  It differs from the more widely known techniques of laser engraving and laser ablation in that it is an additive process, adding material to the substrate surface to form a permanently bonded mark or decoration instead of removing material as is done in those other laser processes. 

For metals, parts can be permanently marked with high contrast and high resolution for identification, logos, bar-coding and serialization purposes, without damage to the substrate. With glass and ceramics, complex surfaces can be decorated or marked; however, the traditional kiln firing process is replaced by a laser, with its permanently bonded decorations and markings fired on in seconds instead of minutes or hours.

Mark quality depends on a variety of factors, including the substrate surface, laser type and power, marking speed and spot size, beam overlap, material thickness and other laser parameters. The resulting marks are permanently bonded to the substrate and, in most cases, they’re as durable as the substrate itself.

LaserBondTM products are supplied in both aerosol spray cans and liquid ink containers. 

For more information visit:  www.laserbondingtech.com

Description:
Datapaq is the preferred supplier of in process temperature profiling solutions to the global industrial market.  Temperature profiling is the process of recording and interpreting temperatures of products as they move through either a conveyorized or batch heating process (typically an oven or furnace). The collected numeric data is converted by temperature analysis software into meaningful information and displayed as a graph – thermal profile.

This information tells you what temperatures your product reached, for how long and at what point of the process. Process engineers know what the perfect profile for their product should be and variations from the ideal indicate a potential problem or unacceptable quality. By analyzing the thermal profile, you are able to verify and improve product quality, increase throughput and solve production problems. 

In 2009, Datapaq joined two other leading brands - Raytek and Ircon, to provide our customers with additional solutions for their industrial manufacturing needs.  As complimentary brands, Raytek and Ircon offer a complete line of infrared sensors, linescanners and thermal imaging systems for use in today’s most demanding environments.  

Together, we are Fluke Process Instruments - a triad of the top performing, innovative, most rugged and dependable noncontact temperature measurement and profiling equipment made – a complete line of infrared sensors, line scanners, thermal imagers and profiling systems for use in today’s most demanding environments.

Some company-wide benefits of this modernization are equipment and process tracking, diagnostics, trending, alarming, reporting, visualizations, and remote access.
	
Following that, we offer long-term support agreements tailored specifically to each system, where we could assist managing these systems in depth, from overall system health, networking guidance, and remote access controls, down to the component level where we can manage hardware obsolescence, build upgrade roadmaps, keep program backups, and provide remote support.

Finally, we build customized training for E/I so they can understand how their systems work and how to use them, which is valuable for both new hires and for refreshing area veterans. These classes range in scope from basic to advanced, and are tailored to specific processors or machines.

What sets our company apart is the fact that our founders were hands-on operators in the cannabis industry. Why is this significant? Because we understand the critical importance of delivering a high-quality pre-roll to consumers. Moreover, we know the value of investing in equipment that performs as promised.

So, what makes the APEHEX different from other pre-roll machines? Firstly, our system uses six individual lanes to produce pre-rolls, unlike the carousel method used by other machines. Why does this matter? If a carousel machine encounters an issue, the entire unit must stop. In contrast, with our individual lane system, you can shut down a single lane if needed, while the rest of the machine continues to operate. Secondly, as former operators, we recognize that each batch of flower has unique properties. The APEHEX is designed for operators to adjust every dynamic setting, allowing it to adapt to the specific characteristics of the flower, resulting in the perfect pre-roll.

APEHEX has over 100 machines operating daily across the US and Canada and has produced over 57 million pre-rolls to date.

We offer various programs, including all-inclusive leases and financed or cash purchase options. Each order comes with a patented FLOWSHREDDER, a high-output, high-speed grinder that creates the perfect particle size for packing.

Name: RBI Corporation
Description:
Founded in 1919 with just four employees, RBI Corporation (formerly Richmond Battery & Ignition) began with a simple mission: providing exceptional service. Back then, we focused on battery maintenance for electric cars! As the automotive aftermarket grew, so did we, expanding into Briggs & Stratton locks and keys.

Fast forward to 1946, RBI was appointed as a distributor for Briggs & Stratton’s small engine division, specializing in gasoline-powered washing machines. Following WWII, we thrived as gasoline-powered equipment revolutionized the lawn and garden industry. Seizing this momentum, RBI expanded into outdoor power equipment parts and hasn’t looked back since.

By 1978, we were fully dedicated to the outdoor power equipment market, moving to a 53,000 square foot facility to meet the growing demand. Our reach didn’t stop there: in 1987, we opened a second location, adding 20,000 square feet of warehouse space. Today, our Albany, GA facility (opened in 2007) and Louisville, KY warehouse (opened in 2008) ensure we can deliver next-day service to our customers across the Southeast, with inventory strategically placed to support our expanding territory.

Our success is built on a foundation of strong relationships with our loyal, independent service dealer network. By maintaining cutting-edge communications and delivering unmatched service, RBI has grown into a trusted name in the outdoor power equipment aftermarket.

As we look to the future, our commitment to exceptional service and our outstanding dealer network position us for continued success in this dynamic and ever-evolving industry.

• Enhance performance - Improve machine performance and control by using the PC NIC, Ethernet cables and EtherCAT infrastructure.

• Scale dynamically - Auto-configure an EtherCAT network when swapping any servo drives and I/O devices.

• Extend easily - Add any 3rd party protocols or open source libraries with no vendor lock-in.

• Improve UX - Build a powerful UI with a world-class Windows Interface (HMI)

Name: InVekTek, LLC
Description:
InVekTek is a technology company focused on mitigating unwanted motion in all material handling applications.  The simple fact is that electric motors stimulate the natural frequency of the loads they drive, and with it unwanted motion. Depending on the application, unwanted motion comes in three flavors: vibration, oscillation, or sway. And regardless of flavor, unwanted motion undermines productivity, compromises accuracy, erodes repeatability, shortens the mean time between failure, is wasted energy and can be a serious safety concern.  All in, unwanted motion is a substantial but hidden expense.

Unwanted Motion is hardly a new phenomenon.  It has long been recognized that the acceleration and deceleration of loads in material handling is governed by Isaac Newton’s First law - a body in motion tends to stay in motion and a body at rest tends to stay at rest. And InVekTek certainly hasn’t repealed Newton First Law. But we have developed proprietary control algorithms to prevent unwanted motion BEFORE THE FACT. Without sensors. Without encoders. Completely open loop. 

InVekTek’s initial target market is industrial cranes.  Everyone knows sway in cranes is a serious problem.  Preventing that sway offers a substantial and immediate financial return by improving productivity, preventing collisions, expediting new operator training, and extending the MTBF of the crane. InVekTek has launched SwayMaster, a configured/sensor less controller that intercepts the operator’s inputs and corrects them to prevent sway while preserving the intended move. And unlike sensor-based systems, SwayMaster automatically compensates for the dynamics of varying heights, payloads, rigging and even the differing skills of individual operators.

To learn more about SwayMaster, check out our website at InVekTek.com or call 608-335-4833.

NOTE:  InVekTek is currently building a network of Value-Add Resellers to help us service our growing customer demand.

- The Duo-Flex diaphragm can easily be replaced in line. The straight through design also facilitates the use of brushes or rods to clean the valve.

- Want to support OPC UA and their industry’s OPC UA Companion Specification.
- Want to Buy (not develop) an OPC UA Server that is quickly deployed.
- Do not have the time, resources, or budget to develop an OPC UA Server.
- Do not have experience developing OPC UA servers.

- Expose edge device data through configuration – no software development required
- Use existing OPC UA Companion Specs or create new Information Models
- Configure the links between the OPC UA Information Model and the Edge Device I/O

Name: MPL Concepts, LLC
Description:
MPL Concepts, LLC is a manufacturer of oil filled polymers used for maintenance-free bearing lubrication.  We offer a finished product, which includes a bearing with MP Lube installed, as well as the option to process bearings supplied by you.

MPLs consist of two major components (oils and polymers) along with other additives and have the appearance of a solid lubricant.  As a bearing operates, its temperature rises and oil is released from the polymer.  When it cools, the polymer acts as a sponge and absorbs the oil, which eliminates the need for relubrication.  The oil is released based on the unique needs of each application and the hardened polymer helps block contaminants from entering the bearing.  (Two of the primary causes of premature bearing failure are lack of proper lubrication and contaminants damaging the internal components.)

There are many industrial applications across most Industries where MPLs can be used to assure consistent lubrication and decrease contamination in bearings, which will increase the likelihood of reaching the intended service life.

Developed for use on high velocity, high pressure air conditioning systems, Spiral pipe has gained wide acceptance for all types of high or medium pressure, above and below ground distribution systems, such as ventilation, dust removal, grain handling, carbon monoxide exhaust and dual wall pipe for sound and thermal insulation. Spiral pipe is available in other materials on special order, such as vinyl-coated steel, brass, copper, aluminum and stainless steel. Spiral galvanized pipe is carefully engineered and built, to meet or exceed all SMACNA standards (Sheet Metal And Contractors National Association).

Name: Synaptix
Description:
Manufacturing loses billions every year to scrap, downtime, rework, quality variation, and suboptimal throughput — losses that are measurable, predictable, and preventable. Yet most production systems still operate reactively, relying on legacy controls, manual tuning, and individual engineering experience, leaving performance dependent on the skill, availability, and judgment of whoever happens to be keeping the system on track. When performance drifts, teams often find out too late — after material has been wasted, production has slowed, quality has suffered, and margin has already been lost.

Synaptix is rewriting this narrative — a next-generation industrial control platform built to unify data-driven system identification, physics-informed digital twins, and optimal control into a continuous optimization engine for continuous manufacturing operations. Synaptix learns dynamic models directly from historical and streaming operational data; these models act as digital twins that predict how processes will respond before any change reaches the factory floor. In simulation, Synaptix optimizes control policies, tunes controller parameters, evaluates performance before deployment, and de-risks change — then pushes optimized control to the line in real time.

This shifts plants from static tuning and alarm-driven response to adaptive, proactive, model-guided control. Instead of reacting to instability, operations run with foresight: detecting variability before it becomes loss, recovering margin through better control, and turning control systems from passive infrastructure into intelligent, self-optimizing assets. Early deployments with industry partners have already demonstrated substantial operational and economic benefit. The next generation of manufacturing will be defined by systems that learn from operations, predict process behavior, and optimize performance in real time — and that is what Synaptix delivers.

Name: CANNAMATIX
Description:
CANNAMATIX is an industry-first, completely secure, automated cannabis cultivation system. We meticulously designed, engineered, and build our Class 100, ISO 5 rated clean-room environments with steel cargo containers to offer a stackable, modular, and fully-scalable cannabis lifecycle management solution for commercial grow operations anywhere in the world.

Administration of the system is simple and done via website or iOS and Android mobile apps. We provide critical plant data & analytics for streamlined management of your containers regardless of geographical location. Stealthy and secure containers mean they can be placed anywhere, off-grid options available that require no local water or power supply.

The sheer amount of data points recorded by the system is almost impossible to put a value on. All data transmitted to and from the containers and the CANNAMATIX server farm is protected by our proprietary end-to-end encryption. Utilizing hardware root of trust that's been pre-validated by our own Blockchain network via zero-trust networking and secured DNS, data traffic can't be logged by ISP's; ensuring totally private communications. In effect, you have the highest level of data privacy in existence on the planet.

Lane Departure Warning

Automatic Cruise Control
Pedestrian Protection
Headlights Control
